sources.publisher: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
sources.note: The six development themes and their descriptions; no subject list

subject_rule: Limited to doctoral research that fits one of the six CSC development themes (Science and technology for development; Improving population health, health systems and capacity; Promoting innovation and entrepreneurship; Strengthening peace, security and governance; Strengthening resilience and response to crises; Access, inclusion and opportunity); the CSC states "These scholarships are offered under the six CSC Development themes" and gives no list of subjects.
notes: No official list of subjects, fields or programmes exists: candidates propose their own doctoral topic, so 0 programmes are recorded for the doctorate level. The six themes are broad development themes, not majors, and were deliberately not stored as programmes.

The theme page says awards are offered "across several science and technology subject areas" for the science theme and "in relevant subjects" for peace, security and governance, but names no subjects.

Exclusion stated on the scholarship page: no new direct financial or promotional support for the fossil fuel energy sector overseas (extraction, production, transportation, refining and marketing of crude oil, natural gas or thermal coal, and fossil-fuel fired power plants).
not_stated: A list of subjects or disciplines.
Whether any named academic discipline is excluded other than fossil fuel energy.
